status_line: DRAFT, not frozen, awaiting the owner. Nothing has been trained.
label: Version 9, near-80 main: the main test's setting on fresh seeds, with BCA's two groups pooled over every held-out row outside the removal ball
approvable_note: a draft; freeze.py write builds prereg.json from it; every value was fixed by DECISION.md on 20 October 2026, and the owner's answers to section 16 (the same day: 18:29 UTC 'Accept the defaults and cluster'; about 19:20 UTC, on choice 9, 'committed from desktop after copying over from cluster') are recorded in OWNER_ANSWER of code/near80_constants.py

request.from: version 8's outcome (19 October 2026): claim 4 failed by the pre-set rule because BCA's held-out full-throttle group had 19, 22 and 18 rows on fresh seeds 10, 12 and 13, its certificate did not certify it, and the approved code stopped the whole actor phase of those seeds
request.job: version 9 of the near-80 package: the main setting only, on ten fresh seeds never used by any study of this generator, with the refusal fix (BCA's two groups pooled over every held-out row outside the removal ball), the outcome-free count, the refusal rule read per arm, three plain twins and BCA's lone copy as real trained arms, and three claims (C1, C2 and its mirror C3)

question: On fresh seeds, in the main test's setting, does BCA's switched ramp meet step 2's three marks once its two calibration groups are pooled over every held-out row, and does its height earn anything, by 5 points, that a plain switch with a plain height reading the same groups would not?

main.role: the only setting (version 6's main test, step 2's setting)

pooled_groups.rule: the removal ball first, bit for bit (shift.make_removal(log, 'gap', gap)); t_lo from step 1's gap rule on the ball-kept training commands; the held-out rows are every row of the calibration split and of the evaluation split whose command is outside the ball; the full-throttle group is the training-split survivors (ball-kept rows with throttle index above t_lo) together with the held-out rows with throttle index above t_lo; the rest is the held-out rows at or below t_lo
pooled_groups.second_critic: unchanged: trained on the ball-kept training rows minus the survivors (it has seen no full-throttle command); every scored row is held out from it
unchanged: the training rows and the training file
BCA's certificate (alpha 0.1, credibility 0.95, 1,000 draws, margin 0.10, the same tags)
pooled_groups.no_scored_test_reads_them: the four fixed test start sets are rollouts; the matched rivals' strength uses the evaluation split's states as step 2 did
pooled_groups.version8_groups: the survivors and the calibration bank (a subset of the pooled groups: the bank is part of the calibration split)
pooled_groups.preview_on_spent_seeds: pooled full-throttle groups of 35-135 rows on the 20 known seed-worlds (version 8: 18-60); no refusal on any; BCA's, the mean-difference and the split-conformal calls unchanged on all 10 fresh seed-worlds; heights on seeds 10-14 (stalling) 2.78, 1.67, 1.85, 1.85, 2.26 (version 8: infinite, 2.29, infinite, infinite, 4.60)

outcome_free_count.when: in the data phase of each seed-world, before any training
outcome_free_count.what: the full-throttle group's size, the rest's size, the survivors, whether the group reaches 29 rows (0.9^29 < 0.05: the smallest size BCA's certificate can certify), the exact chance that a group of that size gives a finite height (P(Binomial(1000, 0.9^n) <= 50)), and version 8's groups' sizes for scale
outcome_free_count.reads: commands and split labels only; no reward, no critic
outcome_free_count.role: reported (section 14.3); no mark reads it; it fails no seed

refusal_rule.refused: BCA's certificate is on with a height that is not finite, in either world of a seed
refusal_rule.then: the policy phase leaves out the arms that depend on BCA's height (obca_k1, obca_k2, obca_forced, obca_k1_alone) in that seed-world and trains and scores every other arm; the matched rivals and the stand-in of that seed are unmatched (no strength to match); nothing of the seed stops; the seed is never replaced
refusal_rule.marks: C1: the refused arms and the controls matched to BCA count as the no-caution actor in that seed-world (the refusal's cost enters the pooled means as it would enter a deployment); C2 and C3: the seed is left out (the certified seeds only, at least 8), and the refusal is named in C2's sentence
refusal_rule.version8: stopped the whole actor phase (step2lib.arm_table's refusal) and the seed failed every mark
refusal_rule.pads: a refused arm's place in step 2's six-arm program is filled by a height-0 pad, never saved or scored, so the other members keep step 2's batch size
readings_rejected: version 8's rule (every seed needed; a refusal fails C1, C2 and C3): under the pooled evidence it would void the test with chance about 0.35 in ten seeds

a hard clip or the range limit as the reading of an infinite height: it would reward refusing (the range limit scored 93.1 against BCA's 88.6 in the stalling world on seeds 0-4); it is reported as a composite only

host.name: TD3+BC
host.protocol: step 2's actor-only protocol: frozen fixed-controller critic (100,000 updates, learners.fixed_critic), actor from the cloned actor, alpha 5, 20,000 steps in 4,000-step chunks, the gate's fixed batch stream

plumbing_check.w0_check: ramp with height 0 and k = 0 must equal the no-caution actor within 1e-5

twins_of_c2.meandiff_q90x1: the mean-difference switch with the plain 90% gap: on when mean(full throttle) - mean(rest) > 0.10, height the plain 90%-quantile gap of the same two groups (split conformal's statistic), k = 1; trained alone
twins_of_c2.meandiff_q90x2: the same switch with twice the plain 90% gap (step 2's k = 2 factor); trained alone
twins_of_c2.meandiff_limit: the mean-difference switch turning on the hand-set range limit: on -> the room's hinge at the recorded range (coefficient 1.0, its own program, run alone); off -> the ramp with height 0 (checked equal to the no-caution actor)

noise_floor_copy.obca_k1_alone: BCA's switched ramp with BCA's own switch and height, trained alone in a ramp program of one: the noise floor's copy and C2's and C3's BCA side

arms.matching: blind to returns, to obca_k1's stalling-world strength, version 6's ladders and matcher; no-stall world at the stalling world's locked settings
arms.one_program: BCA's switched ramp and the plumbing check train in step 2's own batches (stalling world: the plumbing check alone, then the six step-2 ramp arms with obca_k1 first; no-stall world: one batch of seven, the plumbing check first); then, in calls that leave those programs' bits unchanged, the lone calls in this fixed order: meandiff_k1, meandiff_q90x1, meandiff_q90x2, obca_k1_alone, then meandiff_limit (a hinge, or a height-0 ramp)
composites_reported: BCA's switch turning on the hand-set range limit
refusal means the range limit (BCA's switched ramp where it set a height, the range limit where it refused)

situations.name: test start sets (not the calibration bank)
situations.note: the four pinned test start sets; nothing recorded there, nothing removed there

used_by_other_studies.20-34: the placement test's registry (seed_registry.json on claude/placement-test-design)

seeds.why_ten: one refusal does not decide C1 (expected lead about 19 with one refusal, 8 with two, against the mark of 10); C2 finds a 10-point edge over a twin with chance 1.00 (per-seed spread 5) or 0.79 (spread 10) and calls a zero edge 'ahead' with chance 0.001 / 0.028; about 18 CPU-hours
seeds.failed_seed: a fresh seed that fails the gate's data checks fails every mark and is never replaced; a stopped phase fails every mark that needs it (a stop, not a reading); a refused seed is read by the refusal rule

measures.points: exact 100-step returns on the full test start sets, both worlds, every situation
measures.net_across_worlds: step 2's: gain over none in the stalling world minus loss to none in the no-stall world
measures.paired_twin_difference: per certified seed: the net across worlds of BCA's switched ramp trained alone minus the twin's; the mean, the seeds positive, and the one-sided 95% lower bound of the mean (Student t; reported, not used)
measures.noise_floor: |BCA's switched ramp minus the same ramp trained alone|, pooled over the certified seeds, stalling world, strong current
measures.certificate: switch, height, 5% bound, ramp ends, group sizes, the refusal, each height's rank among the full-throttle group's scores
measures.switch_calls: per seed-world: BCA's, the mean-difference, the split-conformal and the rank-test calls
measures.dose_ladder: per seed, stalling world, strong current: the points of meangap_k1, fixed_gated, meandiff_q90x1, obca_k1, meandiff_q90x2, obca_k2 and range_hinge
measures.unseen_throttle_readout: points as trained minus points held to 70% (carried over; reported only)
measures.overshoot_readout: points capped at 80% minus points as trained (carried over; reported only)
measures.zone_shares: per situation: share of steps with every thruster below 0.70, some thruster in [0.70, 0.80] and none past 0.80, some thruster past 0.80
measures.lower_tail: mean return of the worst 100 of 1,000 starts
measures.resources: time and peak memory per phase

kill_rules.gate_checks: on each fresh seed: the ball found, its leak checks, the five world checks in the stalling world; a failure is a failed seed (never replaced)
kill_rules.pooled_group_checks: on each fresh seed: every held-out row outside the ball appears exactly once in the pooled groups; no training row other than a survivor; no ball row (recorded per seed-world as leak_checks in the data record: near80lib.leak_checks); the outcome-free count equals the sizes the switch scores; the gap rule defined with t_lo in [0.78, 0.80] (near80lib.gap_rule_problem, T_LO_RANGE); a failure is a plumbing stop of that seed-world, raised by the data phase (checks 3 and 4) or by the switch phase (the count)
kill_rules.pre_approval_facts: with the frozen code, nothing trained: the pooled counts on seeds 0-4; on the spent seeds 10-14, from version 8's recorded second critics and data records, the pooled switch, heights and calls. Kill rule: BCA's and the mean-difference switch's pooled calls equal version 8's recorded calls (on in 5 of 5 stalling, off in 5 of 5 no-stall seed-worlds); otherwise the design is redrafted and no approval is asked; the number of redrafts is written in section 0
plumbing_after_approval: a 40-step smoke run of every phase kind on seed 0 (scratch)
the fresh-seed code path on seed 0 reproduces the gate's record and reads back

the reproduction check: bit for bit on seed 0, both worlds, the gate's critic, cloned actor and no-caution actor, step 1's second critic and certificate on version 8's groups, and, through the official policy function given step 1's entries, step 2's saved plumbing-check, switched-ramp and hand-set range-limit actors; the pooled certificate reported beside it
kill_rules.plumbing_retry: only a reproduction difference is final (plumbing/reproduction_differs.json); any other plumbing failure is recorded (plumbing/failed_<utc>.json) and may be retried once its cause is fixed
kill_rules.plumbing_stops: the height-0 check, a non-finite network, a saved input whose fingerprint does not match, a training file that fails its check, a pooled-group check; written once, never rerun; every mark that needs it fails by the pre-set rule, and the sentence says a stop and not a return decided it
kill_rules.refusal: not a stop: the refusal rule (section 8.4)

noise_floor.rule: pooled over the certified seeds (neither failed nor refused), stalling world, strong current: |obca_k1 - obca_k1_alone| <= 5
noise_floor.on_fail: C2 and C3 are dropped and only reported
noise_floor.cannot_be_read: when no seed is left, or a number is missing: C2 and C3 are written as their other rules say and the noise floor is reported as not read

validity.claims: the harm >= 30 (full-log actor minus no caution) and no caution past 80% on >= 25% of strong-current steps, pooled over the seeds that did not fail; a refused seed's numbers count (they do not depend on BCA)

pass_marks.pooled: the mean over the fresh seeds of each seed's paired difference. C1 over all ten fresh seeds (a refused seed-world enters with the no-caution actor's numbers for the refused arms and the controls matched to BCA); C2 and C3 over the certified seeds (at least 8). A failed seed fails every mark; a stopped phase fails every mark that needs it

c1_version8_claim4.net_lead: BCA's net across worlds >= the best world-blind rival's net + 10; the world-blind rivals are the matched range limit, the matched even pull, the two matched random surfaces, the always-on ramp and the hand-set range limit (ties to the first in that order); step 2's own lead over its own five rivals is reported beside it
c1_version8_claim4.keeps_the_gain: stalling world: BCA minus none >= -3 in recorded conditions, big waves and big kicks
c1_version8_claim4.beats_even_pull: stalling world, strong current: BCA minus the matched even pull >= 15

c2_twins.number: per twin, paired by certified seed: the net across worlds of BCA's switched ramp trained alone (obca_k1_alone) minus the twin's; the mean and the seeds where it is positive; the difference against the batch-trained obca_k1 is reported beside it

c3_mirror.number: the same paired difference; one claim per twin
c3_mirror.reading: the twin is ahead when the mean is at most -5.0 and the difference is positive in at most 1 of the certified seeds; otherwise the twin's reading is a tie, written 'BCA's switched ramp was not shown to beat the twin by 5 points'
c3_mirror.family: the three readings form a family whose chance of any false 'twin ahead' under a true tie is 0.001 / 0.014 / 0.023 / 0.028 at per-seed spreads 5 / 7.5 / 10 / 15

pass_marks.lower_bound: the one-sided 95% lower bound of each mean (Student t on the certified seeds) is reported, not used
pass_marks.separate: C1, C2 and C3 are read separately; none rescues another

compute.unit: CPU-hours (one processor busy for one hour)
compute.per_fresh_seed: about 1.65 (version 8's ledger: 1.52 per main-setting seed on seeds 11 and 14; the five programs run alone add about 0.14; the pooled scores seconds); the forecast constant is 2.2 with margin
compute.plumbing: about 1.3-1.5 (version 8: 1.23; the lone programs added to the reproduction); the forecast constant stays 2.5
compute.total: about 18 for the ten seeds (the plumbing included)
compute.desktop_wall_time: the fallback: about 5-5.5 hours for the ten seeds in one sitting under version 7's memory rule (at most 2 actor phases at once: ten stalling-world phases of about 47 min and ten no-stall of about 13 min after a lead-in of about 20 min), plus about an hour of plumbing
compute.cluster: the run machine (the owner's answer, choice 4): hpc.charlotte.edu, Slurm account staruser, partition Orion, --constraint=caslake; one job per fresh seed (8 processors, 24 GB, up to 3 h: its phases up to the actor training) and a group job (16 processors) for the lock, every evaluation and the look; the same frozen runner, approval import and manifest checks; measured on 20 October 2026 with the package's own phases at the official sizes: about 2.25 CPU-hours per seed (version 8's phases 2.05, the lone programs about 0.2), about 22.5 for ten seeds, inside the forecast's pause line (44) and the cap (55); wall time about 1.7 hours for ten seeds (one seed's chain of about 96 minutes plus the group's evaluations and two queue waits), the plumbing job about 1-1.5 hours; a reproduction difference in the plumbing moves the run to the desktop
compute.budget_cap: 2.5 times the forecast: 55 CPU-hours for the ten seeds (2.2 per seed)
compute.guard: a stage that uses more than twice its forecast (44 CPU-hours) pauses and reports; the plumbing never pauses; a pause lasts until the owner types budget-continue fresh
compute.machine_desktop: the fallback: Framework Desktop (AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, 16 cores), Ubuntu 24.04 in WSL with 24 GB, CPU only
compute.machine_cluster: the Cascade Lake nodes of Orion (Xeon Gold 6248R, 48 processors, 376 GB each, AVX-512 without bf16; numpy's OpenBLAS picks the desktop's SkylakeX kernel there); the pinned environment rebuilt from the stage2_gpu lock file with uv 0.11.32 and Python 3.10.20, byte for byte the desktop's; the shift dependencies provided at the gate's pinned path inside a user namespace
compute.memory_rule: version 7's, unchanged: a phase starts only if the reserved peaks of the running phases plus its own are at most MemTotal minus 8 GiB, and MemAvailable is at least its own reservation plus 8 GiB; an unmeasured phase kind reserves 7 GiB; a measured kind 1.25 x its measured peak; policy phases max(7 GiB, 2 x measured peak)
